title: Rai Mai Tausayi Tsakanin Annabawa
intro: Murya tana kira zuwa ga adalci tana ratsawa ta cikin ayoyin Alƙur'ani Mai Girma. An bai wa wannan rai mai albarka annabci da littafin Allah a lokacin da ake buƙatar jagora sosai a tsakanin Bani Isra'ila. Wannan mutum ya yi magana kai tsaye ga mutanensu, yana ƙarfafa su zuwa ga ambaton Ubangijinsu. Ta hanyar haƙuri da ibada, sun zama fitilar haske wanda labarinsa ya haskaka shafukan littafi mai tsarki. Za ku iya gano wannan mutum mai ban mamaki wanda sunansa ya shahara a cikin Alƙur'ani da Linjila?
clues: An girmama ni da annabci da kuma littafi na sama a lokacin da mutanena ke cikin bukata.
Mahaifiyata ta haife ni ta hanya mai ban mamaki, ta hanyar umarnin Allah kaɗai.
Na yi wa mutanena jawabi, ina cewa 'Ya ku Bani Isra'ila! Ni manzon Allah ne zuwa gare ku, ina tabbatar da abin da ya gabace ni.'
Na zo da hujjoji bayyanannu daga Ubangijinka, ina yi maka bushara da wani annabi mai suna Ahmad.
Mahaifiyata mace ce mai adalci wadda ta sadaukar da ni ga bautar Allah tun ina ƙarami.
Allah ya koya min Alqur'ani kuma ya sanya ni mai tausayi da biyayya ga mahaifiyata, kuma ban kasance mai girman kai ko rashin biyayya ba.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Yana magana a cikin gadon jariri tun yana jariri
trial.answer: Yana magana a cikin gadon jariri tun yana jariri

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An ɗauke shi zuwa sama cikin jiki
An yi min gwajin kuturta tsawon shekaru
Ya mayar da Isra'ilawa zuwa ga imani
outcome.answer: An ɗauke shi zuwa sama cikin jiki

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
